_readme: The object gate: press something that is not a person.
Until this existed, every interaction the running game ever performed was with an NPC,
so the whole object path - a target with no body, found by the same reach rule, its
record dispatched through Interaction - was covered by unit tests alone. A verb only a
second game uses is a verb the shipped game's gates never touch.
The well is the water tiles at the bottom-left of the town. There is no sign sprite:
an object is an interaction POINT, and what you see is the decor already on the map.
Spawn is tile (4,6). Two tiles down is (4,8), standing on grass with the water - and
the object - directly below. 40 frames at 48px/s is exactly 32px, so the walk lands on
the tile centre rather than near it.

steps.text: walk down to the water's edge
press into the well - it is an object, not an NPC
and it gives control back like any other conversation
